featured_reviews.name: Chandrakala Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic experience here. Big promises were made but nothing delivered. Absolutely pathetic.
•Basic facilities like lift is not accessible. It becomes very difficult for senior citizens to climb the stairs as the banquet is on first floor.
•The place is not hygienic at all nor the staff. The uniform which the staff was wearing was not clean at all.
•The washrooms are in pathetic state. Too smelly and the floor was wet all the time. Someone even puked outside the washroom and it was all smelly. The staff didn’t even bother to clean it. Also the washroom is on the ground floor.
•The decorator Prathamesh added to the disappointment. Pathetic decoration. The flowers used were not at all fresh. It looked like the stage might collapse any moment when the kids were running around. Chairs for guests were very flimsy. Felt like they would break at any point and were not comfortable.
•The centralised air conditioning as well as the bride and grooms changing room ac’s were not working well. It got too hot as the crowd increased. No one bothered to keep a check.
•Coming to the food. When I entered the hall there was a room in which the welcome drink was being prepared. The containers used looked so unclean. Looking at that no one would dare take that drink. The remaining food also was ok and not that great.
•COVID norms not followed at all. No sanitisers, no temperature check.
Hope you find this review helpful and are able to make a better decision.

The hospitality at KCA events is warm and welcoming, reflecting the community's values.

A strong sense of camaraderie and shared tradition.

Engaging conversations and networking opportunities within the community.

I attended my CINTAA ASSOCIATION ANNUAL MEETING HERE ON 01/05/26.I will present an honest appraisal of the place as I experienced it first hand.
First of all it was a grave error on the part of Poonam Dhillon ji, Padmini Kolhapure ji and Deepak Parashar ji to select this place as our annual meeting place.We had guests like Shatrughan Sinha ji and Bobby Deol ji amongst us.In the past during Amrish Puri ji's and Mithun Chakraborty Ji's tenure the meeting was held at Holiday Inn and later when the members swelled it was shifted to UPG auditorium juhu and then DN nagar auditorium.The last two were also better.
This is not a proper auditorium but a makeshift multipurpose place with a normal stage used for myriad functions like marriage and birthday anniversary celebrations.The tower aircons are effective.The stage lighting okay.The trasportable type old style chairs are not meant for sitting for six hours and are very very uncomfortable.If the meeting is going to be held for longer periods The organisers should ensure at least comfortable seating.The front few rows had sofa's which were also not comfortable and had low sitting position.
The meals are served in a semi basement semi open air kind of place.The pedestal fans with evaporation are ineffective during peak summers.I am told that the catering is reasonable as far the charges go,but then the fare served is also just about very average.The service by the bearers is not very visible and the place is meant for smaller gatherings and not large groups. It was a humbling experience standing in long temple like queues. There was a small tandoor in the beginning which slowed the line even further.The tables were few and far between and most people were eating standing or huddled in corners like labourers which was an ugly sight.The washroom was pathetic and totally avoidable.
THE ONLY GOOD THING ABOUT THIS PLACE IS AMPLE PARKING 🅿️ AVAILABLE IN THE ADJACENT OPEN AIR GROUND WHICH IS A BIG RELIEF.The approach road is a narrow and should be navigated with care.
Best wishes to CINTAA ASSOCIATION for next years ANNUAL MEETING and hoping that MVM Banquet management consider updating the dates facilities available and make it more in sync with the times we live in.
THANK YOU 🙏🏽

Furthermore, Orion Events provided top-quality furnishing and decor, including crystal doves and clear Chiavari chairs, which elevated the aesthetic and ambiance of the venue.

Moreover, they took care of church decor and transportation for the bride, groom, and extended family, truly proving to be a one-stop-shop for any event need.

I highly recommend Orion Events to anyone seeking a stress-free, tailored event experience. Wishing Craig and his team all the best in their future endeavors!

featured_reviews.name: Edwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic experience at Josephs Dreamland Park. The only “dreamland” part of this venue is dreaming that basic facilities, hygiene, or decent service might actually exist.

Providing something as simple as a fan was apparently considered a luxury. Guests were expected to sit there sweating and suffering while management behaved as if comfort was some premium add-on. When asked about fans during the wedding, they shamelessly demanded ₹750 per fan. Imagine charging ₹10 lakhs for a venue and still trying to squeeze extra money for the most basic necessity.

When questioned whether this was clearly informed to the bride and groom beforehand, their response was the peak of arrogance and stupidity: “You never asked.” What kind of incompetent management thinks people booking a wedding venue need to specifically ask whether guests will have fans? How does it even cross anyone’s mind that fans would not be available unless specially requested?

The insect situation was equally disgusting. Bugs were continuously dropping onto tables and chairs, giving guests an unforgettable experience in filth and neglect. Hygiene standards here are clearly nonexistent. The real starters of the evening were not fish fingers or chicken fry, but bugs and crickets falling fresh from above. If serving pests was part of the menu, then this venue truly exceeded expectations.

And water for guests? Apparently another luxury item. Not even providing drinking water shows just how cheap, careless, and disgraceful the service truly is.

To make it worse, the host Mr Alex was disgusting — rude, unapologetic, and completely lacking even basic manners or professionalism. They behaved as if doing the guests a favor while delivering third-rate service.

Overall, this place is a complete embarrassment. Greedy management, filthy conditions, zero hospitality, and standards so low they are almost insulting. Charging lakhs while failing at the basics is nothing short of a scam. Avoid this venue at all costs unless you want your special occasion ruined by incompetence and greed.

Extremely Disappointed with Management — Unprofessional Behavior by Mr. Henri Lobo

We had our wedding at Blossom Lawn, Mahakali on 2nd November 2025, and while the venue itself is decent, the management experience was extremely disappointing and completely spoiled the joy of our special day.

Right from the booking stage, we were told the venue timing was 6 PM to 2 AM, and that any time extension would be chargeable on an hourly basis. All discussions and confirmations were done with Mr. Henri Lobo, who manages the property on lease.

However, on the wedding night itself, around 11:30 PM, his staff started repeatedly asking “Kabhi khatam hoga sab?” while our guests were still enjoying the function. When I reminded them about the time extension arrangement, Mr. Henri Lobo arrived and completely denied our previous discussion in a very rude and unprofessional manner. He even said, “2 AM ke baad agar extend hua to you’ll have to pay ₹50,000,” which was completely unacceptable and disrespectful. His behavior and tone spoiled the atmosphere of our celebration.

That wasn’t the only issue. Just two days before the wedding, it rained heavily, so I messaged Mr. Lobo asking about arrangements to protect guests from the rain. He called and told me that we would have to bear the cost of tarpaulin for rain protection. When I questioned why this was not the venue’s responsibility, he bluntly said, “I am not responsible for it — you have to bear the cost.” He later suggested splitting the cost with another wedding happening on 1st November, and I had no choice but to agree to pay ₹15,000 extra on top of the ₹3.2 lakh venue charge.

My biggest mistake was paying the full amount in advance.I strongly advise others not to make full payment before the event — wait until after the function concludes. Because this advance payment left us helpless, and we had to face unnecessary harassment.

During the wedding rituals, his staff kept interrupting and demanding the remaining ₹15,000 repeatedly — which was highly unethical and disrespectful. Despite all payments being cleared, no arrangements were made for the DWAR POOJA, and I personally had to run around to get it managed.

Overall, the unprofessional attitude, lack of accountability, and rude behavior from the management, especially Mr. Henri Lobo, made what should have been a joyful event extremely stressful.

I would strongly recommend future clients to be cautious, keep all communications in writing, avoid paying the full amount upfront , and double-check every commitment before finalizing anything with this venue.
